'''Rorak 5''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] above [[Rorak 4]], near [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>. It was a meeting point of [[Kajidic/Legends|Hutt clan]] leaders, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and traders.

There, [[Krayn]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] bodyguard [[Rashtah]] met in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]] with the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]]<ref name="TCSWE" /> and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Bakleeda]]—[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise, in order to save his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] from the oppressive lifetime fate of being a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]. [[Nor Fik]], the principal Colicoid negotiator, brought "Bakleeda" into the business meeting as a Colicoid advisor and imminent inspector of the Nar Shaddaa [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-processing operations.
